# folder was unreadable at a glance. They are shortened here and recorded below,

# no provenance -- and the identifiers are in docs/case1_forge.md, keyed by the

column3: 518 Phase 2C stations. The gCBGA column is what this case inverts.
Witter 2019 model 1, 268,773 cells. The independent check the case is validated against.
His misfit at the 323 stations he used. Says which 323, and that his RMS was 0.0301 mGal.

Top-of-granite points. From model 2, which the delivery's README calls a TEST case that should not be taken as final -- and it is the only surface shipped, so the reference model is built from it anyway. See P42. The suffix is the warning the old name lacked.
Witter's modelling report. Source of the 2.55 modelling density and the rock densities.
States the 2.67 reduction density the delivered anomaly uses. The evidence for P20.
The delivery's own README. Where the TEST-case warning in P42 is written down.
The delivery's Geoscience Analyst workspace. The only place the original top-of-granite surface is shipped. See F099.
Vertices of the workspace object "Original Top of Granite Surface", written by `_original_surface` in scripts/case1_forge.py. The seismic surface the reference model and the basement are built from.
